title: Recipe
description: A rich and decadent vegan chocolate cake with a refreshing, uplifting mint frosting. This cake is a celebration of strength and sweetness, perfect for sharing and creating positive moments.
name: Vegan Empower-Mint Chocolate Cake

wet.name: Plant-based milk
wet.notes: Such as almond, soy, or oat milk

instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan.
In a large bowl, whisk together all the dry ingredients: flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate medium bowl, combine all the wet ingredients: plant-based milk, vegetable oil, white vinegar, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix. A few small lumps are okay.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and spread it out evenly.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean.
Allow the cake to cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes before carefully inverting it onto a wire rack to cool completely.
While the cake cools, prepare the frosting. In a mixing bowl, beat the softened vegan butter with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
Gradually add the sifted powdered sugar and beat on low speed until combined, then increase to medium-high and beat until smooth.
Beat in the peppermint extract. Add 1 tablespoon of plant-based milk and mix. If the frosting is too thick, add the second tablespoon until you reach a smooth, spreadable consistency.
Once the cake is completely cool, spread the mint frosting evenly over the top.
If desired, sprinkle with vegan chocolate chips for garnish. Slice, serve, and enjoy the uplifting flavor.
notes: For an even richer chocolate flavor, you can substitute 1/2 cup of the plant-based milk with 1/2 cup of cooled, strong-brewed coffee. Ensure the cake is fully cooled before frosting to prevent melting.
